brief: Calculate a fictional account’s total fees from its stated usage and fee schedule.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Add fees for your actual usage"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Suma comisiones según tu uso"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Some tarifas conforme seu uso"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Calculate a fictional account’s total fees from its stated usage and fee schedule.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A monthly headline fee can omit the charges created by actual usage.
instruction.misconception: Comparing only the headline fee while ignoring the stated number of paid transactions or assuming an unearned waiver.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: Read each stated fee and its frequency. Add the monthly charge to the charges generated by your actual usage.
The total includes both the fixed and usage charges.
An unmet waiver condition leaves the stated fee applicable.
Usage-dependent charges require the relevant usage count.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
